args.command: echo '===OPENCLAW==='; systemctl list-unit-files | grep -Ei 'openclaw' || true; systemctl list-units --type=service --all | grep -Ei 'openclaw' || true; ps -ef | grep -Ei '[o]penclaw' || true; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ':18789 ' || true; echo '===OPENCHATX_UNIT==='; test -f /etc/systemd/system/zen-openchatx.service && echo UNIT_EXISTS || echo UNIT_MISSING; systemctl status zen-openchatx.service --no-pager --full 2>&1 | head -60 || true; echo '===OPENCHATX_DIRS==='; du -sh /opt/zen/tools/openchatx-linux-sandbox 2>/dev/null || true; du -sh /var/lib/zen-openchatx 2>/dev/null || true; du -sh /var/lib/zen-ops/work/openchatx-linux-probe 2>/dev/null || true
